about.title: Intelligence, put to work.
about.description:
I’m Abdelrhman Mahmoud Fawzy, an AI & Generative AI Engineer working across machine learning, document intelligence, and software development.

My work brings together LLM orchestration, grounded retrieval, computer vision, and the backend systems that support them. I enjoy turning complex workflows into practical applications, from research assistants to business software.
strengths: Grounded document intelligence and Agentic RAG

bullets: Developed AI-powered applications across computer vision, NLP, Generative AI, automation, and business software, including ViT-based medical image classification and financial and conversational RAG assistants.
Analyzed 30,000+ Facebook comments using sentiment analysis, LDA, BERTopic, LLM-assisted labeling, and Agentic RAG to identify audience trends and emerging topics.

Currently developing a subscription-based, multi-branch POS SaaS using PostgreSQL with Manager, Cashier POS, Kitchen Display System (KDS), and Admin interfaces for inventory, suppliers, reporting, and branch operations.

experiences.organization: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT)
bullets: Fine-tuned PaddleOCR for Egyptian national ID information extraction, achieving a reported 97% accuracy, and applied YOLO Pose for document corner detection.
Developed NotebookLM Light using Qwen3, Ollama, LangChain, LangGraph, MongoDB, and Qdrant for document intelligence, Agentic RAG, and grounded PDF question answering.
Implemented semantic retrieval, contextual conversational memory, editable PowerPoint generation, online/offline research reporting, quizzes, and two-host AI audio overviews.
Developed Marketly.ai, an AI-powered multi-agent marketing intelligence platform using LangChain and Gemini for market intelligence, competitor monitoring, brand analysis, and strategy generation.
Designed data collection workflows for social platforms, brand websites, competitor pages, and review sites using Apify for post collection and Playwright for targeted comment scraping.
Integrated SWOT analysis, trend monitoring, viral post insights, AI-generated marketing content, platform usage metering, and security-related platform controls.
Developed a real-time nursery monitoring system using YOLO for person detection and tracking, combined with Siamese Networks and Triplet Loss for person recognition.
Integrated facial emotion recognition and skeleton-based custom action classification using human pose information.
Built LLM-powered blog content generation workflows with images and interactive analytics dashboards.

projects.title: NotebookLM Light
projects.shortDescription: NotebookLM Light is an AI-powered research and productivity workspace built around uploaded documents and grounded retrieval. It combines PDF-based question answering with source citations, document summarization, editable PowerPoint generation, reports, interactive quizzes, online/offline research workflows, and two-host audio overviews. Local model inference uses Ollama. Optional online research uses external services and requires connectivity.
